summary: Iteration 4 (Wayfair furniture shopping + Citi Offers / Mastercard Offers statement-credit pilot). Backend: 14/14 pytest pass (new tests/test_wayfair_offers.py): 4 products, real LLM SSE streaming for chatgpt (gpt-5.4) and gemini (gemini-3-flash-preview) both emit [[product:id]] tags, cart create/validation (404 bad product, 422 empty/invalid agent), eligibility per sofa (sectional $125, velvet $70, loveseat no-match '$500+' reason, clearance leather 'Clearance items are excluded'), credit cap $150 (2x sectional), activate 400 before lookup / wrong offer id / not eligible, activation idempotent, PATCH resets offer/activation, place_order idempotent with statement_credit, PATCH after order 400, txn persisted, insights.statement_credits delta correct, 403 when chatgpt paused. Frontend (390x844): home has no Citi logo (0 citi-logo testIDs, 0 ), start buttons route to /shop?agent=chatgpt|gemini, compare has 5 rows. ChatGPT eligible path E2E: suggestion -> product-add-wf-arnav-sectional -> check offers -> citi-cart-reference -> faceid -> lookup progress -> offer-credit $125.00 -> Activate -> offer-activated -> cart-offer-activated -> place order -> done-credit '$125.00 back...' -> activity txn-credit-*. Gemini no-offer path via chat-input 'leather sofa on sale' -> clearance reason, no activate button, cart-no-offer, Google Pay. Back x3 to chat, qty +1 and LLM [[add]] auto-added velvet -> re-check PATCHed same cart and re-ran lookup ($70 on $699.99 eligible spend). Order without activation -> no done-credit, 'Citi offer: None'. Loveseat no-offer path (ChatGPT) reason '$500+ ... $389.99'. Agent Controls UI toggle pauses chatgpt -> place-order-error 'ChatGPT is paused in Citi Agent Controls'; re-enable -> order succeeds. Protocol panel titles per step verified for both agents; sheet open/close/backdrop work; restart resets flow. Fixed one React duplicate-key warning in ProtocolPanel. Only minor issues remain.

minor.issue: Agent spending limit (agents.limit) is not enforced - only enabled/revoked is checked. E.g. a $2,202.78 Gemini order succeeded with limit $2000. Confirm whether limit should block orders.

Legacy test files /app/backend/tests/test_citi_agentic_commerce.py and test_multi_cart_insights.py target removed endpoints (checkout_sessions/agentpay/citi authorize) and will fail; delete or archive them.

Either render basic **bold** or instruct the LLM (system_prompt) to reply in plain text without markdown. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/steps/ChatStep.tsx:16

FIXED: duplicate React key on step 2 flow ['Citi Offers','Mastercard Offers','Citi Offers'] (key={f}) caused a red 'Encountered two children with the same key' dev toast. Changed to key={`${i}-${f}`}.

issues: When an offer was eligible but NOT activated, the banner just says 'No Citi offer applied to this cart' - consider hinting that an eligible offer was skipped (go back to activate).
Returning from Wayfair cart to chat needs 3 back taps (cart -> offers -> sign in -> chat); consider jumping back to chat from cart/offers.
